facts.fact: EMARKETER forecasts DOOH ad spending in the US will reach $3.2 billion USD in 2024.
facts.quote: DOOH ad spending in the US will increase 11.2% in 2024 to reach $3.2 billion USD.

facts.fact: EMARKETER forecasts a 2024 annual DOOH growth rate of 19.5% in France.
EMARKETER forecasts a 2024 annual DOOH growth rate of 13.7% in Germany.
The page states that by 2027, DOOH will comprise 75% of the UK's total out-of-home advertising market.
facts.quote: By 2027, DOOH will comprise [75%](https://www.iabuk.com/compass/dooh) of the UK’s total out-of-home (OOH) advertising market.

facts.fact: In a 2023 Proximic survey, 7% of advertisers said DOOH was the most effective ad medium for brand marketing.
facts.quote: In a 2023 survey from Proximic, [7% of advertisers](https://chart-na1.emarketer.com/265743/most-effective-media-brand-marketing-objectives-according-us-advertisers-nov-2023-of-respondents) said DOOH was the most effective ad medium for brand marketing.

facts.fact: In an OAAA and Harris Poll survey, 76% of consumers reported watching a video, dining at a restaurant, or shopping at a store after viewing a DOOH ad.
facts.quote: [76% of consumers](https://oaaa.org/news/new-study-finds-digital-out-of-home-advertising-surpasses-other-media-in-driving-favorability-and-action-among-consumers/) reported watching a video, dining at a restaurant, or shopping at a store after viewing a DOOH ad

facts.fact: Although 27% of OOH advertising in 2023 was for local services and attractions, DOOH is increasingly used by B2B and travel marketers.
facts.quote: Although a reported [27%](https://content-na1.emarketer.com/total-ooh-ad-spending-us-will-surpass-10-billion-first-time-2027-on-moderate-growth) of OOH advertising in 2023 was for local services and attractions

facts.fact: Unlike traditional OOH, DOOH ads are unskippable, appear in contextually relevant environments without relying on 1st or 3rd-party data, and can be used for retargeting.
facts.quote: Unlike traditional OOH, DOOH ads are unskippable, appear in contextually relevant environments without relying on 1st or 3rd-party data, and can even be used for retargeting.

facts.fact: StackAdapt's Creative Studio says its DOOH ad example designed for UK-based agency MOBSTA generated over 14 million impressions (vendor-reported client result).
facts.quote: generated over 14 million impressions with its simple yet stunning design

facts.fact: According to EMARKETER, as cited by StackAdapt, the amount of DOOH ads transacted programmatically is expected to surpass $1 billion USD in 2025 (third-party forecast).
facts.quote: the amount of DOOH ads transacted programmatically is expected to surpass $1 billion USD in 2025
